Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Warehouse Associate position at your biotech company in Zwijnaarde, as advertised by Start People. With hands-on experience in logistics at Katoen Natie and a strong attention to detail, I am confident in my ability to contribute to your team.

In my previous role, I maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced environment, ensuring that all processes ran smoothly. I am comfortable working with computers and Microsoft Office, and I am eager to learn new skills in a GMP/GDP-regulated setting. I am a team player who communicates effectively in English and is committed to following procedures carefully to ensure product quality and safety.

I am looking for a long-term opportunity and am excited about the prospect of joining a company that makes a meaningful difference in patients' lives. I am available to start as soon as possible and can travel to Zwijnaarde with my own transportation.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,

Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Warehouse Associate position at your biotech company in Zwijnaarde, as advertised by Start People. This experience taught me the importance of meticulous attention to detail and adherence to procedures—skills that are directly applicable to handling biological products in a temperature-controlled environment. I am comfortable using computers and Microsoft Office, and I am quick to learn new systems and processes.

I am particularly drawn to this role because of the opportunity to work in a meaningful industry where every task contributes to improving patients' lives. I am a dedicated team player who communicates effectively in English, and I am enthusiastic about learning new skills in a GMP/GDP-regulated setting. I am looking for a long-term position and am excited about the potential to grow within your organization.

I am available to start as soon as possible and can travel to Zwijnaarde with my own transportation. I am flexible with shifts and committed to maintaining the highest standards of quality and safety.

Sincerely,
